lines.trans: Our boss handpicked this hotel and had the suite redecorated—please make yourself at home.
All the other artists stay together, yet our boss gave special instructions to house you separately.
Our production crew can be blunt; the boss hopes you will not take it to heart or misunderstand.
Calling a brawl a misunderstanding? You people ought to face legal liability!
Our schedule on Charming Voyage is super tight—next week we fly out to shoot on location.
This week we finish training at home, and starting tomorrow camera operators follow you nonstop.
Under show rules, every detail of your daily routine must be handled directly by our directing team.
We have assigned assistants, a nutritionist, and security standing by twenty-four hours next door.
So all the handlers you brought from your agency may head on back now.
Out of the question—we must stay right beside Mr Jia!
Since Mr Jia agrees to our professional setup, rest well—I will take my leave!
